_comment: Requirements that enumerate a set of members. ODP-SA-06 has no per-requirement acceptance criteria -- its Trigger and Acceptance columns are the same boilerplate seventy-one times -- so nothing said whether the eighth constraint class or the fifth release mode was required. This file is the narrow substitute: for requirements that list N things, the N things are written down, each satisfied member names where it lives, and each absent member carries an auditable disposition. Adding a requirement here is cheap; leaving a gap unwritten or claiming an unverified decision is what the check refuses.

_source_provenance.policy: Repo transcriptions and amendments are not canonical sources. A canonical record requires a version, exact location, and SHA-256 of the source bytes; unavailable authority remains BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE.

canonical_source.blocked_reason: Neither expected path exists at the pinned ref; the repository amendment only declares amends and does not contain the original artifact.

repo_transcription.scope: Cause 02 and Appendix A summarize ODP-SA-06 but are repo evidence, not the canonical specification.

ODP-SA-06.recheck: Obtain the original artifact or immutable source ref from Product/source custodian, then record version, exact location, and SHA-256.

canonical_source.blocked_reason: No standalone requirement artifact or source row with verifiable version, location, and bytes was found; the repo contains only an AVM-001 summary in the verification report.

repo_transcription.scope: Appendix A AVM-001 row summarizes GM_TTM, GM_FWD, depreciation, asset, lease, and normalization; it is not the full FR text.

ODP-FR-AVM-001.recheck: Confirm whether AVM-001 belongs to the original ODP-SA-06 artifact or a separate canonical AVM document, then hash the retrieved source bytes.

requirements.statement: 系統必須考量資本、租約、施工、設備、人力、覆蓋、稀釋與時序硬限制。

members.name: DILUTION
members.note: A per-catchment cap on OPEN actions. Cannibalisation is pairwise between sites and the model is linear, so this is the part of the effect a count can carry, not the whole effect. DECIDED 2026-09-02: the full pairwise form is not pursued. Linearising it costs O(n^2) auxiliary variables, but the deciding reason is that the pairwise dilution coefficients are themselves model outputs carrying substantial uncertainty -- optimising precisely against uncertain coefficients manufactures precision the inputs do not support. The better next investment is the measurement: ODP-FR-HZ-004 absorption now produces realised dilution figures, and improving those changes the answer more than improving the optimisation over the current ones.

disposition.scope: NetPlan linear solver optimization in ODP core
disposition.reopen_trigger: When pairwise dilution coefficient estimation uncertainty is reduced below optimization sensitivity threshold
disposition.rationale: Catchment count cap implemented and verified; pairwise form formally amended per ODP_REQUIREMENT_DISPOSITIONS.md

members.name: LEASE
members.note: Per-option lease availability windows and early termination cost schedules are absent across candidate site feeds and core.stores schemas per ODP_NET002_LEASE_DATA_READINESS_2026-09-03.md. No decorative constraint is wired. ConstraintClass.LEASE is reported in unmodelled_constraint_classes on every solve, displayed in Operator UI, and requires explicit acknowledgement/policy governance. Formal handback HB-NET002-LEASE-001 submitted to Human/Ops and Architecture Board per docs/evidence/ODP_NET002_LEASE_DISPOSITION_2026-09-03.md.

disposition.evidence_needed: Store lease contract master data (lease_expiry_date, break clauses, termination penalties in core.store_leases/CLM) and automated candidate site lease feed with freshness SLA and signing deadlines
disposition.evidence_owner: Store Operations Lead / Real Estate Finance Lead / Data Platform Lead
disposition.rationale: Batch 0 audit confirmed production system lacks per-store lease expiry/penalties and automated candidate listing feed. Wiring fake constraints or treating None as 0.0 violates fail-closed principles. Maintained in unmodelled_constraint_classes; handback package HB-NET002-LEASE-001 submitted to Human/Ops and Architecture Board per ODP_NET002_LEASE_DISPOSITION_2026-09-03.md.
disposition.reopen_trigger: Store lease contract master table (core.store_leases or CLM) is deployed with per-store lease_expiry_date and early termination penalty formula, and candidate site partner feed is contracted with signing deadline and fitout grace days.

members.name: SEQUENCING
members.note: Needs a time dimension: per-period resource caps and precedence between actions. ActionOption.period_key is carried and reported but never constrained. DECIDED 2026-09-02: not modelled, and not scheduled. A per-period constraint is only worth having if per-period capacity data exists to feed it, and it does not -- construction and labour capacity are supplied to the solver as single totals. A constraint fed by a figure nobody measures is decorative, which is the pattern this work exists to remove. The risk it would have covered (a plan reported feasible while unschedulable) is already handled by ConstraintClass.SEQUENCING appearing in unmodelled_constraint_classes on every solve. Revisit when a planning cycle needs per-period sequencing AND the per-period capacity figures exist.

disposition.scope: NetPlan linear solver optimization in ODP core
disposition.reopen_trigger: When planning cycle needs per-period sequencing AND per-period capacity figures exist
disposition.rationale: Per-period constraint without per-period capacity data is decorative; reported through unmodelled_constraint_classes

members.name: CHAMPION_CHALLENGER
members.note: Compares champion and challenger predictions against a tolerance and recommends rollback. Note this compares prediction agreement, not metrics against a baseline -- see ODP-FR-LH-005.

members.name: BACKTEST
members.note: Backtest is connected as a versioned release admission gate for FULL and CANARY releases, binding model version, dataset snapshot, code version (git SHA), and DecisionPolicy thresholds.

members.name: ADJUST
members.note: Recommendation is CONTINUE/SCALE/STOP/CHANGE_CHANNEL/INCONCLUSIVE -- AdLift's vocabulary, which satisfies ODP-FR-AD-005 exactly and leaves no place for Adjust. InterventionStatus runs EXECUTING to OBSERVING to EVALUATING to COMPLETED with rollback as the only mid-course exit, so there is no state for 'modify and continue' either.

disposition.rationale: AdLift vocabulary uses Continue/Scale/Stop; lifecycle adjusting state pending business requirement clarification (Batch 6).

requirements.statement: 所有長時間任務都能查詢 QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED/PARTIAL。

members.name: PARTIAL
members.note: JobStatus in shared/governance/vocabularies.py now carries PARTIAL per ODP-FR-SHARED-001, but no job in the tree currently reports it. The vocabulary fork between queue.py and listings.py was resolved under ODP-JOBSTATUS-OUTCOME-VS-DELIVERY-001 by separating outcome from delivery mechanics. The Batch 5b producer trace under ODP-JOB-PARTIAL-PRODUCER-EVIDENCE-001 closed the tree-level question against every registered job type and named the partial-shaped outcomes that are deliberately not mapped onto JobStatus.

history.note: Gap registered by the disposition registry: the vocabulary carries PARTIAL, no producer was found.
ODP-JOB-PARTIAL-PRODUCER-EVIDENCE-001 finished the static producer trace. What is left is not more code reading.

disposition.evidence_needed: Two things, neither of which the tree can answer. (1) A live production queue/scheduler/worker receipt inventory, to say whether any deployed job has ever reported JobStatus.PARTIAL; the repo trace only establishes that no code path writes it. (2) A product decision on whether the partial-shaped command outcomes that do exist -- batch intake 207 per-row receipts, XLSX partial commit, external ingestion accepted/quarantined counts -- should become durable jobs carrying member-level receipts and a member retry contract.
disposition.rationale: JobStatus vocabulary declares PARTIAL but no long-running batch job currently produces partial status (Batch 5b). The producer trace walked the default registry (forecast, external-fetch, assisted-listing-intake) and every module worker entry point and found no PARTIAL write. The partial-shaped outcomes that do exist are synchronous command receipts, not queue jobs; wiring them onto JobStatus to complete the member count would be the fake implementation this gate exists to prevent.

requirements.statement: 系統必須組合 External Demand、Brand Transfer、Format Conversion、Ramp、Seasonality。

members.name: BRAND_TRANSFER
members.note: core.brands holds static metadata only; brand_transfer_view.sql is a synthetic mock view (cross join with fixed 0.15 transfer_ratio and 1.0 confidence) unconsumed by SiteScore; no producer in repo. Evidence request ER-SITE001-BRAND-TRANSFER-001 and formal handback HB-SITE001-BRAND-TRANSFER-001 submitted to Human/Ops and Architecture Board per docs/evidence/ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-03.md.

Handback package HB-SITE001-BRAND-TRANSFER-001 submitted to Human/Ops and Architecture Board for data ingestion contract or formal amendment per ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-03.md.

members.name: FORMAT_CONVERSION
members.note: PostgreSQL (000001) and SQLite (000004) schemas maintain static store_format_code with no format conversion event or renovation history tables; TargetFormatRegistry only selects format by area (new store selection, not conversion); simulator.py only models greenfield new stores. Production-path conversion hits are Listing-to-Candidate conversion or Evidence Level migration notes. Evidence request ER-SITE001-FORMAT-CONVERSION-001 and formal handback HB-SITE001-FORMAT-CONVERSION-001 submitted per docs/evidence/ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-03.md.

disposition.evidence_needed: Active store format conversion operational workflow playbook, brownfield financial simulation parameters (downtime loss, capex schedules), and conversion event schema confirmation
disposition.evidence_owner: Retail Operations Lead / Site Economics Lead
disposition.rationale: Repo contains only static store format codes and greenfield simulation logic; no format conversion event tracking or remodeling financial model exists in repo. Handback package HB-SITE001-FORMAT-CONVERSION-001 submitted to Human/Ops and Architecture Board for operational playbook confirmation or formal amendment per ODP_SITE001_COMPONENT_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-03.md.
disposition.reopen_trigger: Store Operations formally approves a brownfield format conversion playbook with remodeling cost schedules and downtime impact parameters; schema migration introduces store format transition event tables and tracking with authoritative owner sign-off.

requirements.statement: 系統必須監控 Data/Feature/Prediction/Performance Drift。

members.name: FEATURE_DRIFT
members.note: Per-column drift from the same Evidently DataDriftPreset run; drifted_columns and drift_share carry it.

members.name: PREDICTION_DRIFT
members.note: Nothing monitors the distribution of model outputs. DataDriftPreset is the only preset used anywhere in the tree.

disposition.rationale: Evidently prediction distribution drift monitor scheduled for implementation in Batch 4a.

members.name: PERFORMANCE_DRIFT
members.note: Performance drift compares observed metrics against baseline_metrics using absolute/relative degradation thresholds and governed decision policies.

requirements.statement: 整合層必須支援 Batch、CDC、API、File 與 Event 來源攝取模式。

members.name: EVENT
members.note: The machine_status_event schema contract declares integration_mode=event_stream and envelope=event, but in production core.machine_status_events is populated via batch watermark reads of device_log (store.py:394-401). No event broker/stream consumer currently exists in production.

disposition.rationale: Schema contract declares event_stream mode but production ingestion path executes via device_log batch ingestion; reconcile contract or implement event consumer.

members.name: CDC
members.note: Audited in ODP_INT001_CDC_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_2026-09-03.md and ODP_INT001_CDC_DISPOSITION_2026-09-03.md. No production upstream requires CDC for change log, ordering, latency, or delete semantics; downstream data plane has no delete propagation path; change stream credentials require expanded cluster-level privileges. Maintained as absent; handback submitted for formal human requirement amendment / waiver governance.

disposition.rationale: No production upstream requires CDC; downstream sink has no delete path; credential boundary expansion unapproved. AI cannot self-sign waivers; pending human governance amendment/waiver authorization.

members.name: ROOT_CAUSE_CANDIDATE
members.note: No automated root-cause deduction producer exists in the current production tree. Keep the schema field explicitly marked RESERVED (unproduced), with designated Owner (ForecastOps / Platform Ops) and Target Milestone (Wave 5+). Do not synthesize a fake producer.

disposition.rationale: Full-tree lineage trace confirms no automated root-cause producer exists. The compatible WorkOrder, presentation, and database contracts are explicitly marked RESERVED (unproduced), and the real producer work is assigned to ForecastOps / Platform Ops for Wave 5+; do not manufacture a fake heuristic producer.
